newsitem.title: USA: Total World "prepared to cooperate" with Worldwide.
newsitem.headline: Total World "prepared to cooperate" with Worldwide.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc confirmed Wednesday it has received an offer from Worldwide Leisure Corp to acquire 80 percent of its capital stock and said it is "prepared to cooperate" with Worldwide.
Total World, a switch-based long distance carrier, said it will meet with Worldwide's representatives "in the immediate future" to discuss the terms of the deal.
The company said it is waiting for information regarding the background of Worldwide and its proposal.
Worldwide reported Wednesday that it is prepared to offer $33 million for 80 percent of Total World's stock.
